How Can Biclique Covers Help in Matching
Problems
Otfried Cheong # Ñ
SCALGO, Aarhus, Denmark

      Abstract
In several settings one encounters assignment or matching problems between objects of two different
types, and needs to run a computation on a bipartite graph. While this graph can potentially be
dense, it can sometimes be represented compactly using a biclique cover. This is in particular often
the case when the objects are geometric – we will look at examples, and see how recent progress on
maximum flow can be combined with such biclique covers to obtain faster algorithms.
